technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with rising RSI and supertrend support offset by weak trend strength (ADX 18.1), bearish stochastic cross, and lack of volume confirmation; insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 54 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 12) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity mixed with one senior sale offset by two junior purchases; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (347.2) with flat yield curve and imminent NFP event create severe macro headwinds; earnings in 54 days poses moderate binary risk but is secondary to acute volatility environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Rising RSI (9 and 14) with supertrend bullish signal and extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy zone) offer tactical momentum entry near support at 105.521.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis regime (VIX 347.2), weak trend confirmation (ADX 18.1), bearish stochastic cross, price below both 50/200 EMAs, zero volume confirmation, and imminent NFP event create severe headwinds that overwhelm technical momentum.
